description: Edit surface: lineage tools vs script-writes over the grand tour + tours corpus. Primary metric: total USD per completed task; threshold ≥25% median reduction with equal-or-better check-pass rate.

tasks.prompt: In {corpus}/grand-tour.hick, rename the linear congruential generator function `lcg` to `linear_congruential` everywhere it appears (definition, calls, and any prose that names it). Keep the document weaving cleanly.
In {corpus}/grand-tour.hick, change the deterministic RNG seed constant from its current value to 20260806 and update any woven output that shows the derived numbers by re-running the document.

Add a `median(xs)` function to the woven analysis module of {corpus}/grand-tour.hick (the document assembles analysis.py from prose-ordered fragments). Place it with the other statistics helpers and add a one-sentence prose introduction in the document.

One expectation in {corpus}/grand-tour.hick asserts an exact figure from the quarterly table. Change the underlying computation to round to 2 decimal places and update the expectation so `hick check` passes.
Reword the opening paragraph of {corpus}/grand-tour.hick (the one beginning 'This is an executable document') to be two sentences, keeping the meaning. Do not touch any code cell.
Add a new executable cell near the end of {corpus}/grand-tour.hick that prints the min, max, and mean of the quarterly totals, with a short prose lead-in.
In {corpus}/grand-tour.hick, the assembled module docstring names the source path. Update the docstring fragment so it also states the license line 'License: MIT.' as its final line.
In {corpus}/text-tools-tour.hick, change the sample input text so it contains exactly five words, and update every expectation that depends on the word count.
Add one more pipeline step to {corpus}/text-tools-tour.hick that uppercases the final output, with a one-line prose explanation and a matching expectation.
In {corpus}/bootstrap-ci.hick, change the confidence level from its current value to 90% and update the prose sentence that states the level plus any expectation on the interval bounds.
In {corpus}/bootstrap-ci.hick, rename the variable holding the resample count to `n_resamples` everywhere (code and prose).

The woven file {corpus}/grand-tour.md contains the phrase 'prose order'. Change that phrase to 'reading order' at its first occurrence by editing at the correct source location so the change survives a re-weave.
